## instantaneous \- regeneration

action\_type: instantaneous  
attack\_type: utility  
notes: the CRA regenerates 2d20 hp. it has to be inflamed to do this.

## passive \- inflame

action\_type: passive  
attack\_type: utility  
notes: when a CRA dies, it usually comes back to life. if not immediately, later in the dungeon. when it does, it has a triple multiattack instead of a double multiattack and some more abilities unlock. it’s health refreshes as well.

## passive \- multiattack

action\_type: passive  
attack\_type: utility  
notes: this creature can attack twice

# lore

Criegenhalomyer usually doesn’t make his monsters personally and just makes them self assemble in a pit of hate. But the CRAs have to be manually put together by him.  
That’s why, most of the time. It’s head literally says. CRA on it.
